---
*Three* is an algorithmic work for flute, alto flute and clarinet. Since it is generated by a computer program that uses random numbers, a different version of this work is output at each execution. Thus, it is recommended that the performers generate a new version for each concert. Also, the performers may play more than one single version on a same concert.
